description: Nightcall: while a night run is on (see /nightcall:start), a finished turn is sent back to the next step instead of stopping. Off by itself at the end time, on MORNING.md, or on a STOP file in the task folder. The hook goes through the step 0 guard - hooks/python.sh in sh and Git Bash, hooks/python.ps1 in PowerShell (Windows without Git Bash): without a real Python 3 it does nothing and never pops Apple's developer-tools window.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" nightcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.py"
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) nightcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.py"
